title: Tamper-evident ledger for every published pick (hash before tip, verify after settlement)
how_it_works: each pick is hashed over its frozen core fields; the entries are then chained (chain_hash = sha256(previous chain_hash, this pick_hash)) and the head of the chain is committed to git on this branch, so a later edit to any published pick changes a hash that is already public. The pre-tip claim is anchored to the git blob of the frozen file, not to a timestamp this script invented.

gates.verification_status: chain head published with this roll; settlement verification runs after each game day ends and its stamp is stored beside the settled rows

verify_after_settlement.note: the settlement file references the same git blob; recomputing the hashes from it reproduces the entry hashes recorded above, so a settlement cannot silently move a line.
